name: invoice-management-system
description: Production-ready Invoice & Billing system (Vyapar / My BillBook inspired)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,server,client -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev:db -w server" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:server: node server/scripts/install-chrome.js && npm run build -w server
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w client && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('client/dist/index.html', 'client/dist/404.html')" && gh-pages -d client/dist
scripts.electron:build: npm run build -w client && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w client && cd client && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run android:sync && cd client/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
